description: My equipment today stands 5 meter from the river Maas in the Netherlands. picture view left picture view right At the beginning and at the end of the recording is calm. In between; many container ships, tugs, yachts, freighters pass, sometimes just on 30 meter. Beautiful, the lapping of the waves against the rock-side! In the background are the birds heard. Lovely the cuckoo in the distance. The shore has a rock dike. You hear the water splash between the stone sometimes. Across the river shows a woman walking her dog. He barks occasionally. Even if the ships are far away you can hear the pounding of the engines. To the right is a railway bridge over the river. If the wind changes you'll hear him. The traffic on the other bridge is sometimes audible. The blackbird, warbler, duck, pheasant are many more birds heard. And insects naturally on this first day of summer. The wind is weak and comes from all directions. Do not be alarmed by the air raid after 30 minutes. It's just a monthly exercise. Then the church bells ring long in the distance. The world has a happy couple again :-) Sometimes you hear people on the other side. The Meuse (Maas) river is a part of the great rivers that runs through our country. I'm at a crossroads of waterways. The main river, and opening to a lock (see picture 'view right'). Recorded on a walk close to my home in Essex, UK (furthest distance from home was just under a kilometre).  This involved walking through a housing estate then along an unmade path bordered by trees, bushes and close to a meadow.

Birds that can be heard include the following with approximate timings (this list is not exhaustive).

0.00 Blackbird
0.51 Great Tit
1.16 Blackbird Alarm Call
1.30 Blue Tit
1.36 Wren
2.12 Song Thrush
3.37 Robin
4.10 Wood Pigeon and Great Tit
4.25 Blackbird
5.17 Blue Tit
6.42 Great Spotted Woodpecker
7.26 Great Tit
7.52 Chiffchaff
8.41 Blackbird

Other birds that can be heard include pheasant, carrion crow, dunnock, Canada geese in flight and a peacock.

Recorded with parabolic mic attached to a Zoom F6 on 3rd April, 2022.

name: children fishermen river Dieze Village Engelen 759 pm 260905_00013
description:
Calm summer’s evening at the river. Children and adults are fishing by the river. They are speaking Polish and German to one another. It seems they are all friends and are chatting happily amongst themselves. There is a friendly atmosphere here.
About the picture The photograph shows a tranquil river or wide watercourse in a rural setting during the early evening. In the foreground lies a strip of grassland with some dry, beige-coloured plants and low vegetation. The water itself is calm and as smooth as glass, gently reflecting the light colours of the sky. Across the water stands a row of tall trees standing close together, forming a natural green wall. A few houses are visible through the trees. A road runs alongside these houses, with a couple of fishermen’s cars parked at the water’s edge. Further in the background, behind the row of trees, stand several large wind turbines. They stand out, slender and white, against the sky, emphasising the open, flat landscape. The sky is largely clear with a few light clouds, and the sunlight is warm and soft. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and rural: a quiet waterside, nature and human presence in balance, with a hint of modern energy generation from the wind turbines in the distance.
What you here #0:01 The clock on the ‘old St Lambert’s Church’ strikes 8 o’clock. #0:13 A green woodpecker calls out. #2:35 #3:03 #9:44 In the distance, a train (sometimes two) rumbles across the old railway bridge over the Meuse. #4:02 Two young children are running up and down and are clearly having fun. #4:47 People walk past along the marl footpath. #6:00 Further on, anglers have their radios playing softly. You can hear the radios now and then. #6:28 #8:11 #11:38 #15:39 You can hear the children’s father casting his rod. I haven’t seen anyone catch anything this evening. #8:50 The anglers on the opposite bank are using a remote-controlled mini-boat to set their bait. The boat passes by here. #14:00 High in the sky, an aeroplane is heading towards the sun. #21:49 Sometimes you can hear the traffic on the other side. #22:58 You can hear the bite alarm – a little bell – on a fisherman’s rod on the other side of the water. #25:18 Just a quick glimpse of an insect as it flies past. #28:41 Don’t be alarmed by the explosion in the distance. #29:25 In the distance, an ambulance races past on the motorway. #30:02 The church bell strikes half past eight. name: field forest winter 006 NL 201216_0209.wav
description: Quiet afternoon in winter field Dec 2020. Far the sound of civilization. Here, also from a distance, some birds in the field. I recognize the crow and the jay. For a moment a blackbird with a short alarm call. He will not sing until a few weeks later. The ladies on horses stare across the fields and chat with each other. They slowly approach the path. With every breeze the last leaves of the oak tree fall. A rooster on the farm in the distance crows for a moment. Recorded on the border of deserted forests and fields. Behind me is the De Loonse En Drunense Duinen nature reserve with mainly pine trees. To the left a sandy path with deciduous trees and, just like before me, deserted lands. The Date/time: December 16th 2020, 12:12 noon Weather: 8-9c, sun, wind SSE 2 bft with gusts to 24 km/h, 1015 hPa, humidity 95-90%.
